description: Aree di circolazione ciclabili is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sancascianovaldipesa.ldpgis.it. Longitudinal part of the road, suitably delimited, reserved for the circulation of cycles.The cycle path may be built:a. in its own location, with a single or double direction of travel, if its seat is physically separated from that relating to motor vehicles and pedestrians, through suitable longitudinal partition physically impassable;b. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Bicycle circulation areas" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Reti di trasporto, progetto-opendata-highvalue. The listing shows 4 download or service links in ZIP, WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
